# **Feature reflection**

## Products

One feature that stood out to me was the Products section. While exploring Shopify, I noticed how easy it is to add product information, images, pricing, and descriptions all in one place. I can see that this feature would help businesses keep their online store organized and make products more appealing to customers.

## Collections

I also found the Collections feature useful because it allows products to be grouped into categories. This makes it easier for customers to browse a store and quickly find what they are looking for. For businesses with many products, I think this feature would improve the overall shopping experience.

## Customers

The Customers section helps keep customer information and purchase history. Retailers can use this information to better understand their customers and provide more personalized experiences. This seems important for building long-term customer relationships.

## Analytics

The Analytics feature was one of the most interesting parts of Shopify for me. It provides information about sales, customer activity, and store performance. I can see how business owners could use these insights to make better decisions and improve their marketing efforts.

## Discounts

The Discounts feature allows retailers to create promotions and special offers. I think this is a useful tool because discounts can encourage customers to make purchases and help businesses attract more traffic to their store.

# **CPP Farm Store application reflection**

After learning how Shopify works, I can see that it could help CPP Farm Store expand its presence beyond the physical store. Shopify would allow the Farm Store to showcase products online, organize items into categories, and provide customers with an easy way to learn about available products. Especially when CPP Farm Store has over 10,000 items in stock. Overall, I think Shopify could support CPP Farm Store's omnichannel strategy by connecting in-store and online shopping experiences.
